title: Sycophancy to Subterfuge: Investigating Reward Tampering in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using a natural language political sycophancy dataset to measure how often the model's answers conform to the user's implied political views.
Testing whether the model misrepresents the truth to flatter a user (e.g., artificially giving a high score to poor-quality poetry) in order to conform to implied user preferences.
